overview: Asteroxylon mackiei provides one specimen-level example of early lycopsid rooting architecture; its anatomy should not be generalized to every lycophyte.

ecology.habitat: Terrestrial; wetland to diverse modern habitats across the clade
ecology.locomotion: Plants remain rooted in place as they grow.
ecology.bodySize: Small herbaceous forms to extinct tree-sized lycopsids
ecology.guild: Primary producer; no single clade-wide ecological guild

traits: Asteroxylon root-bearing and rooting axes as a species-level exemplar
evidenceSummary: Three-dimensional reconstruction of the Rhynie chert fossil directly supports the anatomy of Asteroxylon. It does not establish a direct ancestor, a body plan shared by every lycophyte, or the clade's 425 Ma endpoint.

title.en: A branching system preserved in three dimensions

text.en: Asteroxylon mackiei from the Rhynie chert preserves leafy shoots, axes bearing roots and separate rooting axes. The three-dimensional reconstruction makes this one extinct lycopsid's branching architecture visible. It is an anatomical case study, not a direct ancestor of living lycophytes or a body plan shared by the whole lineage.
text.zh: Asteroxylon mackiei 来自 Rhynie 燧石，保存了带叶的枝条、长有根的轴，以及另一些专门用于扎根的轴。三维重建使这一已灭绝石松类的分枝结构得以观察。它是解剖学个案，不是现生石松植物的直系祖先，也不能代表整个支系的共同体型。

overview: Metzgeriothallus sharonae is the central fossil in this account: a Middle Devonian liverwort preserved as a body fossil. Older Ordovician spore masses may be related, but they do not establish a crown-liverwort assignment.
overviewZh:
本档案以 Metzgeriothallus sharonae 为核心：这件吉维特期化石提供了苔类的实体化石证据。更早的奥陶纪孢子团可能与苔类有关，但尚不能据此确认其属于地钱门冠群。

化石材料呈叶状配子体形态，具有中肋和二叉分枝，并伴有孢子体孢蒴。研究将其解释为小型陆生初级生产者；具体基质和湿度并未直接保存，样本也不能代表所有现生苔类的生态与体型。

ecology.diet: Like other small terrestrial primary producers, the profiled plant made its own food by photosynthesis.
ecology.habitat: The fossil is associated with moist terrestrial substrates, but the exact surface and moisture conditions were not directly observed.
ecology.locomotion: The profiled plant grew in place; this account treats it as sessile rather than mobile.
ecology.bodySize: The fossil is interpreted as a small thalloid gametophyte. It does not establish a body-size range for the whole phylum.
ecology.guild: The sample represents a small land-based primary producer; it cannot define every ecological role among living liverworts.
ecology.habitatZh: 化石与潮湿的陆生基质相关，但其确切的表面和湿度条件并未直接观察到。
ecology.locomotionZh: 所述植物在原地生长；本条将其视为固着而非可移动的生物。
ecology.bodySizeZh: 该化石被解释为一种小型叶状配子体。它不能确定整个门的体型范围。

traits: The fossil preserves a thalloid gametophyte, the plant form described in this account.
Metzgeriothallus has a medial costa, or central ridge, and a bifurcating thallus.
The fossil sample also includes a sporophyte capsule associated with the plant material.
evidenceSummary: Givetian specimens support a liverwort body-fossil record and its anatomy. Older cryptospores and sporangia remain uncertain in affinity, so they do not securely move the first established crown-liverwort evidence earlier.
evidenceSummaryZh: 吉维特期标本支持苔类的实体化石记录及其形态。更早的隐孢子和孢子囊化石亲缘关系仍有限，因此这里不将其用作地钱门冠群的可靠首现证据。
traitsZh: 化石保存了叶状配子体，这是本条记述所描述的植物形态。
Metzgeriothallus 具有中肋（中央隆脊）和分叉的叶状体。
化石样本还包括一个与植物材料相关的孢子体蒴。

overview: Aglaophyton major is represented here by Edwards's re-examination of new and historical Rhynie-chert material, which established the genus and reconstructed its axes and conducting strand without assigning it to a living higher group.

ecology.diet: Photosynthetic land-plant identity; carbon acquisition was not measured in the fossils
ecology.habitat: Rhynie Chert depositional context; the cited redescription does not establish a genus-wide habitat
ecology.locomotion: Sessile growth reconstructed from decumbent and upright axes
ecology.bodySize: Short plant reconstructed from sampled axes; no genus-wide population range
ecology.guild: Primary producer by plant identity; no detailed ecological guild is assigned

traits: Decumbent axes forming stands in the reconstruction
Dichotomously branching upright axes with terminal sporangia
Three-zoned conducting strand without differential wall thickenings
evidenceSummary: The 1986 redescription directly supports the named genus, sampled anatomy and reconstruction. The separate Rhynie U-Pb study supplies only a locality-age window, not a global genus duration, direct ancestor or settled higher placement.

title.en: Branching axes and a distinctive conducting strand
title.zh: 分枝茎轴与独特的输导组织

text.en:
Edwards’s redescription of new and historical Rhynie Chert material established Aglaophyton major and reconstructed both low, decumbent axes and upright, repeatedly forked shoots. The upright axes ended in sporangia, the structures that produce spores. In the stems, the conducting strand was divided into three zones but lacked differential wall thickenings.

These specimens support a reconstruction of the plant’s sampled anatomy, not a placement in a living higher plant group. A separate U–Pb study constrains the age of the Rhynie locality; that date is not the duration of Aglaophyton as a genus, a global range, or proof that it was a direct ancestor of later plants.
text.zh:
Edwards 对新发现及历史上的 Rhynie 燧石材料重新描述，确立了 Aglaophyton major，并复原出贴地生长的茎轴和向上伸展、反复二歧分枝的枝条。直立枝条末端具有孢子囊，即产生孢子的结构。茎内输导组织分为三个区域，但没有差异化的细胞壁加厚。

这些标本支持对所采样植物解剖结构的复原，却没有把它归入现生植物的某个高阶类群。另一项铀—铅研究约束的是 Rhynie 地点的年代；这个日期不是 Aglaophyton 属的延续时间或全球分布，也不能证明它是后期植物的直系祖先。

overview: Horneophyton lignieri is represented by a 24-section museum sample, with three historical thin sections selected for confocal imaging that revised the interpretation of its conducting tissues without making the fossil a direct ancestor.

ecology.diet: Photosynthetic land-plant identity; carbon acquisition was not measured in the fossils
ecology.habitat: Rhynie Chert sinter-surface association reported in the study context; ecological breadth is unresolved
ecology.locomotion: Sessile growth; locomotor performance does not apply
ecology.bodySize: Diminutive reconstructed plant; the sampled thin sections do not define a population range
ecology.guild: Primary producer by plant identity; transport function remains inferred from preserved cells

traits: Rhizoid-bearing rhizome and bifurcating aerial axes in the reconstruction
Papillate wall ingrowths in conducting cells
No distinct xylem and phloem recovered by the confocal analysis
evidenceSummary: Confocal microscopy and three-dimensional modelling directly document cell-wall form in named NHMUK slides. Transfer-cell resemblance and transport function remain interpretations, while the independent locality-age window is not a global range or origin date.

title.en: Three slides open a window into an early plant
title.zh: 三张切片打开早期植物的一扇窗口

text.en: Horneophyton lignieri is known from Rhynie Chert material in Scotland. The study checked 24 museum sections and chose three historical thin sections for confocal imaging. Its reconstruction shows a rhizoid-bearing rhizome and branching aerial axes, but this small selected sample does not establish the plant's full size range or ecological breadth.
text.zh: Horneophyton lignieri 的化石来自苏格兰莱尼燧石。研究核验了馆藏中的 24 张切片，再选出三张历史薄片进行共聚焦成像。复原显示植物有带假根的根茎和分枝地上轴；但这组经过筛选的少量样本不能给出其完整体型范围或生态广度。

title.en: Cell walls are observed; their role is inferred
title.zh: 观察到细胞壁，功能仍靠解释

text.en: The imaged conducting cells have papillate, labyrinth-like wall ingrowths. The study compares them with transfer cells, which move materials between tissues, and discusses a transport role. It did not identify distinct xylem and phloem in these sections, and a resemblance does not by itself prove the cells' exact job. The plant is associated with Rhynie sinter surfaces; the sample does not measure carbon uptake or a population-wide habitat preference. The 411.5 ± 1.3 Ma zircon age constrains the deposit, not each fossil slide directly.
text.zh: 成像显示输导细胞的细胞壁具有乳突状、迷宫状内突。研究将它们与负责组织间物质交换的转移细胞比较，并讨论可能的运输作用。但这些切片没有显示彼此独立的木质部和韧皮部；外形相似本身不能证明细胞的确切功能。该植物与莱尼硅华表面有关联，样本没有测量碳吸收或整个种群的栖地偏好。411.5 ± 1.3 Ma 的锆石年龄约束的是沉积地层，并非直接测定每张化石切片。
